how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-eastern-plaguelands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6133:details:0: The high elves of the Quel'Lithien lodge possesses something that belongs to me, ⟦46⟧: A document detailing my life as a mortal.
rows.quest:6133:details:1: Before you ask; no, you most certainly are not privy to such information. Just do as I tell you, worm: Recover the registry.
rows.quest:6133:details:2: And imbecile, be sure to leave as much strife and grief as possible in your wake. Leave them suffering...
rows.quest:6133:completion:0: I trust you did not read the registry. Not even you would do something that idiotic...
rows.quest:6135:obj:0: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a ⟦E65⟧ and return it to ⟦E39⟧ Blightcaller.
rows.quest:6135:obj:1: It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
rows.quest:6135:details:0: Up until now, you have completed the missions I have assigned; even if not in the most timely manner.
rows.quest:6135:details:1: I suppose you think that you are ready for a challenge. Yes... Yes, imbecile, perhaps you are ready for a more involved set of missions.
rows.quest:6135:details:2: The albino ⟦E6⟧ bat, Duskwing, roams the countryside just north of here. Track him down and destroy him. Return to me with a patch of his white fur and you shall be rewarded.⟦48⟧
rows.quest:6135:progress:0: I would not recommend that you take on this challenge alone, ⟦49⟧.
rows.quest:6135:completion:0: Excellent work, imbecile. I shall fashion this fur into something you can use.
rows.quest:6136:obj:0: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of ⟦E4⟧ and destroy him. ⟦E44⟧ Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
rows.quest:6136:details:0: Past the ⟦E41⟧ encampment of Light's ⟦E42⟧ and west of Northdale, you will find the corpulent maggot beast, Borelgore.
rows.quest:6136:details:1: I've lost entire regiments to that monster. His size knows no bounds! The more he eats the greater his girth becomes...
rows.quest:6136:details:2: While I would not suffer any emotional harm should the beast devour you, I would prefer that you were the victor. Borelgore has been known to devour others who tried to hunt him.
rows.quest:6136:progress:0: Have I told you lately that I hate you?
rows.quest:6136:completion:0: Keep this up and I may have to promote you from imbecile to mental deficient, first class.
